title: Reproducible Capsule Manifest
description: Contract for a reproducible-infrastructure capsule manifest. A capsule is the byte-deterministic output of a dependency-light generator, hash-pinned for integrity and regenerable for reproducibility. It proves infrastructure reproducibility ONLY and is never empirical evidence: is_empirical_evidence is fixed false and evidence_class is fixed REPRODUCIBLE_INFRASTRUCTURE_PROOF. Unknown top-level fields fail validation so a capsule cannot be malformed silently.

schema_version.description: Pinned schema identity. Bump the vN suffix on any breaking envelope change.

capsule_id.description: Stable lowercase identifier for the capsule lineage.

artifact_role.description: Fixed role. A reproducible capsule instruments integrity/reproducibility; it is not a research or evidence artifact.

evidence_class.description: Fixed evidence class. The capsule proves the infrastructure reproduces; it asserts nothing empirical.

is_empirical_evidence.description: Always false. A reproducible capsule may never be interpreted as empirical market evidence.

generator.description: The exact command that regenerates the bundle bit-for-bit.

git_sha.description: Repository git SHA the capsule was generated against (provenance).

source_date_epoch.description: Pinned SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH under which the bundle is byte-reproducible.

created_at_utc.description: Deterministic creation time derived from source_date_epoch (UTC, trailing Z).

verify_command.description: The command that proves on-disk bytes equal a fresh regeneration.

artifacts.description: Hash-pinned bundle files. Every path is repo-relative; every digest is SHA-256.

path.description: Repo-relative path. Absolute paths and '..' traversal are rejected.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the artifact file.

bytes.description: Size of the artifact in bytes.

sha256_manifest.description: SHA-256 of the bundle's own SHA256SUMS file (manifest-of-manifests anchor).

claim_boundary.description: Plain-language boundary: infrastructure reproducibility only, never empirical market evidence.
